tweets.text:
there's currently a bifurcation of crypto traders, those on CT & those in the trenches

memecoins are essentially a game of (3,3) the longer the associated holder group decides not to sell and the coin gets more attention from others the higher the market cap goes, this is what happened with all of the top memes last cycle, made easier by bull market and prices of other crypto assets going up across the board, but there were also a lot of memecoins that died very early last cycle and especially so before the standard was locking the LP

as this was happening and terminals got more advanced there has emerged a second group of traders who are the ones actively trading new pairs, the axiom kids who are using multiple wallets and average hold times of < 5 minutes, they realized that trading new pairs was a more consistent game to play than the (3,3) game most of CT was playing

CT needs someone to blame when coins go down, which is why pumpfun receives most of the anger from ppl on here, but it is not pumpfun who is buying these coins sub 10k mcap and selling them extremely quickly, they are just the infrastructure, & their protocol is used the most actively by this group of trenchers so a lot of their updates are for that group

whenever i mention a coin, theres a group of ppl buying afterwards who werent already in, but theres also a group of ppl selling into them that were already holding the coin, i dont frontrun my own mentions on lowcaps, i dont think thats ethical, but for the trenchers trading these things nonstop they want ppl mentioning the coins as much as possible, so they dont care if "KOL"s are multiwalleting + calling because theyre usually in the coins around the same time as them if not earlier & doing the same thing, they are aware of how pvp the game is that they're playing

the reason there are the "degen" callout rewards, as well as the "diamond" callout rewards is because pump has to provide incentives for all parts of their ecosystem, & pump cannot make the coins go up on their own, only traders agreeing to diamond hand coins to much higher market caps can, which is why that callout reward bucket is for ppl holding coins for a longer period of time and doing callouts on higher market cap tokens

being honest i didnt understand what exactly was going on in the trenches until a few months ago either because i just dont trade those coins, & i couldnt understand how pump was making so much money but it seemed like everyone on here hated them, but if you go to dv or one of the other trenchers streams you'll see they consistently have like 2k views, threadguy in comparison who is best CT streamer imo has like 20% of that because he is doing analysis on stocks, crypto, tech, but he isnt trenching new pairs, its an entirely different group of traders

solving the (3,3) game requires building something different than what pump inherently is, its what im attempting to solve with solana:9cRCn9rGT8V2imeM2BaKs13yhMEais3ruM3rPvTGpump, but i think calling someone like cupsey a rapist is dumb, he is just very good at playing the game in front of him
